description: JSON Schema for Pi's native JSON event stream format, as a harness within the Sheaf quest log envelope. Maps Pi's --mode JSON output (session header + agent/turn/message/tool events) to the same tagged-wrapper structure used by cursor, codex, and claude_code harnesses.

messages.description: Final assistant messages at agent completion.

oneOf.description: Pi session header — emitted once as the first line of a --mode JSON output. Wraps Pi's version metadata in the standard quest log envelope.

cwd.description: Working directory from the Pi session header.

oneOf.title: PiSessionHeaderEvent

oneOf.description: Agent start event from Pi's JSON mode.
oneOf.title: PiAgentStartEvent

oneOf.description: Agent end event from Pi's JSON mode, wrapping final assistant messages.

messages.description: Final assistant messages at agent completion.

oneOf.title: PiAgentEndEvent

oneOf.description: Turn start event from Pi's JSON mode.
oneOf.title: PiTurnStartEvent

oneOf.description: Turn end event from Pi's JSON mode, wrapping the assistant message and optional tool results.
oneOf.title: PiTurnEndEvent

oneOf.description: Message start event from Pi's JSON mode.
oneOf.title: PiMessageStartEvent

oneOf.description: Message update event from Pi's JSON mode — carries a partial assistant message update (text delta, reasoning, or tool call delta).
oneOf.title: PiMessageUpdateEvent

oneOf.description: Message end event from Pi's JSON mode.
oneOf.title: PiMessageEndEvent

oneOf.description: Tool execution start event from Pi's JSON mode.
oneOf.title: PiToolExecutionStartEvent

oneOf.description: Tool execution update event from Pi's JSON mode.
oneOf.title: PiToolExecutionUpdateEvent

oneOf.description: Tool execution end event from Pi's JSON mode.
oneOf.title: PiToolExecutionEndEvent

oneOf.description: Compaction start event from Pi's JSON mode.
oneOf.title: PiCompactionStartEvent

oneOf.description: Compaction end event from Pi's JSON mode.
oneOf.title: PiCompactionEndEvent

oneOf.description: Auto retry start event from Pi's JSON mode.
oneOf.title: PiAutoRetryStartEvent

oneOf.description: Auto retry end event from Pi's JSON mode.
oneOf.title: PiAutoRetryEndEvent

oneOf.description: Queue update event from Pi's JSON mode — emits the full pending steering and follow-up queues whenever they change.
oneOf.title: PiQueueUpdateEvent

PiSessionHeader.description: Session header emitted as the first line of Pi's --mode JSON output.
PiSessionHeader.title: PiSessionHeader

PiAgentStart.description: Agent lifecycle event — marks the beginning of a full agent run (all turns).
PiAgentStart.title: PiAgentStart

PiAgentEnd.description: Agent lifecycle event — marks the end of a full agent run. Wraps final assistant messages.

messages.description: Final assistant messages at agent completion.

PiAgentEnd.title: PiAgentEnd

PiAgentMessage.description: Base message type from pi-ai, used in agent_end and turn_end events.
PiAgentMessage.title: PiAgentMessage

content.description: Array of content blocks (text, thinking, or tool call).

fromId.description: Entry ID that this branch summary branched from.

PiContentBlock.description: Content block from a Pi message — text, thinking, or tool call.
PiContentBlock.title: PiContentBlock

PiTurnStart.description: Turn lifecycle event — marks the beginning of a single assistant turn (one prompt → one assistant response).
PiTurnStart.title: PiTurnStart

PiTurnEnd.description: Turn lifecycle event — marks the end of a single assistant turn. Wraps the assistant message and tool results.

toolResults.description: Tool result messages for this turn.

PiTurnEnd.title: PiTurnEnd

PiMessageStart.description: Message lifecycle event — marks the beginning of an assistant message (text, thinking, or tool call).
PiMessageStart.title: PiMessageStart

PiMessageUpdate.description: Message lifecycle event — provides a partial update to an in-progress assistant message (text delta, reasoning delta, or tool call delta).

assistantMessageEvent.description: The streaming event payload — text_delta, thinking_delta, or input_json_delta.

PiMessageUpdate.title: PiMessageUpdate

PiAssistantMessageEvent.description: Streaming event payload from an assistant message update.
PiAssistantMessageEvent.title: PiAssistantMessageEvent

PiMessageEnd.description: Message lifecycle event — marks the end of an assistant message.
PiMessageEnd.title: PiMessageEnd

PiToolExecutionStart.description: Tool execution event — marks the beginning of a tool call execution.
PiToolExecutionStart.title: PiToolExecutionStart

PiToolExecutionUpdate.description: Tool execution event — provides a partial result during a streaming tool execution.
PiToolExecutionUpdate.title: PiToolExecutionUpdate

PiToolExecutionEnd.description: Tool execution event — marks the completion of a tool call. Includes the final result and error status.
PiToolExecutionEnd.title: PiToolExecutionEnd

PiCompactionStart.description: Compaction event — marks the beginning of context compaction.
PiCompactionStart.title: PiCompactionStart

PiCompactionEnd.description: Compaction event — marks the end of context compaction. Includes the compaction result and whether it was aborted.
PiCompactionEnd.title: PiCompactionEnd

PiAutoRetryStart.description: Auto retry event — marks the beginning of a retry attempt.
PiAutoRetryStart.title: PiAutoRetryStart

PiAutoRetryEnd.description: Auto retry event — marks the completion of a retry attempt.
PiAutoRetryEnd.title: PiAutoRetryEnd

PiQueueUpdate.description: Queue update event — emits the full pending steering and follow-up queues whenever they change.
PiQueueUpdate.title: PiQueueUpdate

PiPayload.description: Discriminated union over all Pi JSON mode event types. Matches the type field to determine the variant.
PiPayload.title: PiPayload

title: Pi Events (Quest Log Envelope)

x-source.description: Schema derived from Pi's --mode JSON output specification and source types in packages/agent/src/types.ts, packages/coding-agent/src/core/agent-session.ts, packages/ai/src/types.ts, and packages/coding-agent/src/core/messages.ts.
